name: China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd.
summary: China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate development and management. It also offers property and asset management services, and other services. The company was formerly known as AVIC SUNDA Holding Company Limited and changed its name to China Merchants Property Operation and Service Co., Ltd. in December 2019. China Merchants Property Operation & Service Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
